prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create an inviting complete school plaza for TOKKATSU広場 populated ENTIRELY by adorable original ANIMAL MASCOTS.
Reference 1 is STRICT CHARACTER AND ART STYLE GUIDE: preserve the exact 4 non-human animal mascots, 2D dark outlines, faces, colors and props. Reference 2 is the ACTUAL CURRENT HOMEPAGE illustration, use for familiar school-campus components and overall school identity only. Improve quality, activity legibility and character size substantially over reference 2.
ONE finished wide 2:1 landscape full-bleed illustration. A SINGLE connected cheerful school campus, no split panels or dividers. NO HUMANS ANYWHERE. Every participant is a round friendly animal mascot, no human hair or human-faced animal costumes. NO 3D rendering. Match reference 1's premium clean 2D cartoon with warm bold charcoal outlines, large organic solid color shapes, at most one subtle flat shadow, no textures, no grain, no gradient, no glossy plastic, no realistic environments. A lovingly art-directed memorable original character world, not generic clipart. Restrained detail, strong silhouettes and large clear faces.
Homepage palette: sky blue #A9E1F5, cream #FCFBF7 buildings, school blue #3A6EA5 roofs, green #2FBA68 and forest green #1F5C3F rounded trees, warm pale sand ground with golden #E8C547 accents, warm vermilion #D2552A. Confident charming rounded hand-drawn curves. Build a school with a recognizable CLOCK on blue-roofed cream schoolhouse in upper background, lower gym nearby, rounded trees, restrained flowers, few fluffy white clouds. Wide curved schoolyard and walking paths connect the foreground activities. No metal fence grid or busy ground pattern. Top 30% environment, bottom70% four vivid activity scenes and LARGE engaging characters. All faces must read clearly at ordinary desktop display size. Each main mascot about 35% of total frame height; 2 supporting animal pupils per scene. 12 animals total, no distant tiny crowds. Main 4 characters and all heads inside safe margins.

LEFT TO RIGHT, seamlessly integrated:
1 GREEN CLASS MEETING: forest-green bear 学活くん with exact round ears, cream muzzle/belly, short paws, white discussion card with two green lines. Leads a small class meeting in an open-front cutaway room with rounded desks forming a semicircle, charcoal-green chalkboard and 3-5 colored proposal cards with NO words. Supporting cream rabbit raises a paw to speak, small tan cat records on paper; all three faces visible. Bear facilitates, no teacher. Show eye contact and listening, not everyone waving at viewer. Main bear full-body beside desks, green identity dominant.
2 VERMILION SCHOOL SPORTS DAY: exact orange rabbit 行人 with bent ear, white sports headband, cream belly, yellow triangular flag cheers a relay handoff. Two supporting plump animals (small cream puppy and tan bear) in red/white sports caps are running with clearly bent springy short legs and handing over a red baton; both joyful faces visible. Curved white running-track lines, short triangular bunting establish sports day. Main orange rabbit beside track, flag fully visible.
3 BLUE STUDENT COUNCIL: exact round blue bird 児童会ちゃん with side feather puffs, yellow beak, cream chest, yellow diagonal sash and microphone stands on very low rounded wooden stage, welcoming two animal pupils. One greenish small cat raises paw, one cream bunny holds a white agenda board with red circle, green triangle, blue square. All faces three-quarter visible, active animal-led assembly. Matching nearby noticeboard has simple symbol cards, no text. Main blue bird large and visibly a bird, NOT a human.
4 YELLOW CLUB ACTIVITIES: exact yellow puppy クラブマン with floppy brown ears, blue headband, little vermilion cape, single white star outlined dark on chest, joyful paws lifted next to two animal friends MAKING things. A small orange cat paints a bold flower at small easel; a small cream bear builds a wooden model glider on low rounded table. Creative activity recognizable with simple brush, palette and glider, not clutter. Big tree frames this zone. Main puppy entire body and short tail/cape visible.

Composition has warm school familiarity, playful mascot charm, faces and shared activities as focal points. Keep the original animal roster's simplicity; even supporting animals same family shape grammar. Do not shrink principal characters for expansive scenery. No typography or names in image; website adds its own accessible text. No watermark, logos, fantasy game franchise props, dangerous tools or chemicals. No decorative confetti or sparkle clutter. Retain role props precisely. The overall scene feels designed for the current homepage's bold cream/dark-line visual language, now with professionally polished adorable character-based world.
